Name: Universal Crop Regrowth
Author: MarsXsyper
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Universal Crop Regrowth makes normally single-harvest crops regrow after harvesting, including most modded crops. It automatically respects crops and mods that already define their own regrowth behavior.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Makes normally single-harvest crops regrow after harvesting.[/*]
[*]Preserves crops that already have their own regrowth behavior.[/*]
[*]Multiple configurable regrowth modes, including percentage-based, fixed days, final growth phase, next-day regrowth, and a custom formula.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu, for changing settings in-game.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Universal Crop Regrowth.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]UniversalCropRegrowth[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
